rationale: This change narrows existing CFA3/FA3 development and shared task-scope admission so execution remains bound to the explicitly requested result, forbids self-generated subtasks and automatic post-completion work, and limits blocker resolution to the minimum necessary work inside the requested-result scope. It does not add or change a runner, provider, model, device/resource path, host service, hardware behavior, execution authority, Current Host proof recipe, or promotion path. The existing runtime mechanism is unchanged; only scope admission semantics are tightened. Therefore no fresh physical Current Host requalification is required.
